title: Desk quote
description: A desk's end-of-day quote for one instrument: the bid, the ask and the mid, and the venue it came from.

ID.description: The quote's identifier, one per instrument.

INSTRUMENT.description: What is quoted: a currency pair, a bond or a commodity.

CURRENCY.description: The currency the price is in.

BID.description: The price a buyer will pay.

AS_OF.description: When the quote was struck (the business date comes from it).
